title: Potato Mujadara
subtitle: black lentils and potatoes
description: A mujadara-style dish of small black lentils and boiled potatoes fried with browned onion, garlic and baharat.

steps.text: Soak the lentils in water for 2 hours and drain (if you are in a hurry you can skip the soaking).
Fill a pot with water, add the lentils and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and cook, covered, until the lentils are tender (30-40 minutes). Drain.
Meanwhile, cook the potatoes in their skins in a covered pot with water and 2 tbsp salt until tender (30-40 minutes). Drain, cool and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-low heat. Fry the thinly sliced onion for 4 minutes until browned. Add the chopped garlic and fry for another minute.
Increase the heat and add the potatoes and lentils. Season with baharat, salt and pepper and fry for 5 minutes, stirring.
